research.text: I work on advancing the mathematical foundations of AI and developing novel algorithms for biomedical applications. Advancing mathematical foundations of AI : I am most interested in understanding feature learning (the ability of AI models to discover patterns from data). My current research is focused on discovering general mechanisms for feature learning (like the Average Gradient Outer Product – AGOP) that can help us better understand the structure in data that is learned by large-scale AI systems. Ultimately, the goal of this research program is to use these new feature learning mechanisms to develop a new class of interpretable, effective, and computationally-efficient AI models that can uncover structure in massive heterogeneous datasets.
